g.text: Equivalent size in the iid model

path.style: stroke: #b96828; stroke-width: 2

g.text: Observed finite-pool accuracy compared with a homogeneous iid majority model
Model input: p = observed one-person accuracy = 63.09% | Half credit for ties
EXPLORATORY PREVIEW · A descriptive model comparison; no new uncertainty analysis.
Existing data: 465 games, 113 people, 9,788 complete responses; uniform finite-pool panels without replacement.
The gap does not identify social dependence: item difficulty, voter heterogeneity and finite sampling also differ.
Equivalent size uses first crossing on the full integer grid, with linear interpolation; odd/even plateaus are retained.
Source: Rutchick et al. (2020), NBA Study 3 release; existing repository panel_curves.csv.
